title: Xdrip+ connected to BluCon - Values are not stable
body:
Hi there, 
Thank you so much for developing the xdrip+ linkup to Blucon. It's my first time using Xdrip+The values are jumping from 4.1 to 18.0 within a few minutes of each other. Is the normal within the first few hours of setup?  I will send info across from my device. Thanks

comments.body: Thank you for the report and for the received logs, can you confirm that you are not also using the official app which might interfere if it was attempting to talk to the device at the same time? The logs look unusual.

Thanks for your quick reply. Yes I think you may have been right. I didn't
think to disconnect the official app.

Thank you so much for integrating the blucon with your app. My eight year
old has diabetes. The linkup is making things better for us already.
